entities.summary: Ulanda Mtamba is a Malawian campaigner for education who is against child marriage. She became a President of Rotary International in Limbe and named on the BBC's 100 Women list as one of the world's inspiring and influential women in 2023. She is the country director of Advancing Girls Education in Africa. 9% of girls in Malawi are married by the age of fifteen.
